sections.heading: context
sections.markdown: MONTHLY_IC 2026-09-05. Four repeat kill pairs exist in the ledger: TXN, SMFG, ELSA, DSNG (two kills each). A second kill of the same name is not automatically a re-affirmation of the first kill's reason.

sections.heading: belief
sections.markdown: Re-killing a name whose thesis was previously killed re-affirms the first kill's dispositive reason, without re-testing whether that reason has gone stale.

sections.heading: outcome
sections.markdown: Repeat kills did not all earn. TXN: both kills avoided further loss (07-13 −17.0%, 08-19 −5.1%). DSNG: the second kill left +20.6% more. SMFG: the second kill left +9.8% more. ELSA: the second kill left +5.0% more.

sections.heading: cause
sections.markdown: `thesis_wrong` at the second decision — external re-rating (complex/macro) was not distinguished from name-specific deterioration. Where the first reason was a name/valuation call but the complex or macro had re-rated, the second kill repeated a now-stale reason.

sections.heading: rule
sections.markdown: Before a second kill of a previously killed name, re-test whether the first reason is now wrong (external re-rating vs name-specific deterioration); TXN-style repeats earn, DSNG-style repeats cost.

sections.heading: evidence
sections.markdown:
- T-GLOBAL-TXN-001 (07-13 valuation, −17.0%) and T-GLOBAL-TXN-002 (08-19 valuation, −5.1%) — reaffirmed correctly
- T-INDO-DSNG-001 (07-13 valuation, +39.0%) then T-INDO-DSNG-002 (08-19 liquidity, +20.6%) — second kill continued a stale reason
- T-GLOBAL-SMFG-001 (07-13 process, +6.1%) then T-GLOBAL-SMFG-002 (08-05 valuation, +9.8%) — second kill left gains
- T-INDO-ELSA-001 (07-13 process, +14.1%) then T-INDO-ELSA-002 (08-05 process, +5.0%) — second kill left gains
- Applicability: JUDGE verdict text (step 7, reason_tag) covers the single dispositive reason but has no second-kill re-test; this rule adds that specific test. The calibration-feedback role text covers generic drift; this names the exact trigger.
